Watch face

Motion·by @itshassco·2026-08-25·inspora page·original post

What it is

Minimal analog watch face ('the most useless watch face'): a sparse dial with only 12/3/6/9 numerals and tick dots, thin black hour/minute hands and a red seconds hand that sweeps with a smooth (not ticking) motion; a side panel offers mode, style (Minimal/Classic?), color accents, and a 'Buy me a coffee' link.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-100%
Light grey dial, small tick marks + 4 numerals; hands at various positions across frames - red seconds hand sweeps continuously (visible at 9, 6, 3 positions), minute hand advances subtly; panel on left: MODE toggle (Analog), STYLE pills (Minimal...), color dots row (black, cream, yellow, white), 'SUNRISE/SUNSET'?, support link, 'CO'WATCH' footer. Numerals and ticks stay perfectly still - only hands move.

Build prompt

Build a minimal analog watch. Dial 400px on #ECECEA: 60 hairline ticks (major at quarters), only 12/3/6/9 numerals in a light grotesk, small date pill ('Sun, 23 Aug') bottom-right of the dial. Hands: 1.5px black hour/minute with rounded caps, red 1px seconds with a counterweight tail; rotate from real time - seconds hand angle = (s + ms/1000)*6deg for a smooth quartz sweep. Style variants switchable from a left panel: MODE pills (Analog/Digital), STYLE segmented control (Minimal/Classic/Watch?), an accent color dot row (black, sand, yellow, white) that recolors the seconds hand and ticks, 'Buy me a coffee' support link, tiny 'CO'WATCH' wordmark. Mechanical variant: seconds hand ticks per second with a 120ms overshoot spring (6deg + 1deg settle).
